definitions.explanation: food preserved by soaking in vinegar, or the pickling method itself

examples.japanese: {野菜|やさい}の{酢漬|すづ}けを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made pickled vegetables in vinegar.

examples.japanese: きゅうりの{酢漬|すづ}けはさっぱりしている。
examples.english: Cucumbers pickled in vinegar have a refreshing taste.

examples.japanese: {酢漬|すづ}けにした{玉|たま}ねぎを{サラダ|さらだ}に{入|い}れる。
examples.english: I add vinegar-pickled onions to the salad.

notes:
USAGE:
- 〜の{酢漬|すづ}け (~ pickled in vinegar)
- {酢漬|すづ}けにする (to pickle in vinegar)

COMMON ITEMS:
- きゅうりの{酢漬|すづ}け (pickled cucumbers)
- {玉|たま}ねぎの{酢漬|すづ}け (pickled onions)
- {生姜|しょうが}の{酢漬|すづ}け (pickled ginger)
- ニシンの{酢漬|すづ}け (pickled herring)

RELATED PICKLE TYPES:
- {糠漬|ぬかづ}け (rice bran pickles)
- {味噌漬|みそづ}け (miso pickles)
- {粕漬|かすづ}け (sake lees pickles)
- {塩漬|しおづ}け (salt pickles)
